notes: Lives in rust-stdlib-crypto because it replaces the generator of crypto/rand (rust_stdlib cannot depend on the crypto crate). The stream is SHA-256 in counter mode over the seed, not ChaCha8, so bytes differ from Go's for a given seed (the way algorithms consume randomness is unspecified in Go as well).

SetGlobalRandom.note: The crypto crate cannot see testing::T, so the function returns a GlobalRandom guard to hand to t.cleanup(move || drop(guard)) instead of registering the cleanup itself, and it does not check for parallel tests. The stream for a seed is SHA-256 in counter mode, not Go's ChaCha8, so the bytes differ from Go's.
